modConnectionTitle: STFC is running without the Daystrom mod
modConnectionBody: There is no connection to the Daystrom mod. Mod features are unavailable for the affected game sessions. End the affected STFC instances, then start them again through Daystrom.
gameStartFailedBody: At least one STFC instance started through Daystrom did not report a ready game interface. Other running game instances will not be ended. If this happens again, reinstall the Daystrom mod and check that STFC is up to date.
gameStatusUnclearBody: Daystrom cannot determine whether the game interface is ready with this STFC version. The game and mod features may still work normally.
